ROW.COLUMN: (ML/AD) Address Associated with Multiple, Recurring External Entities

Money launderers may attempt to conceal their true identity by providing false names, identifiers, and/or addresses. Launderers and their agents may utilize various, often fictitious names when purchasing or redeeming strings of monetary instruments and sending or receiving funds transfers. They may repeatedly utilize the same address, which is often a drop location. Or, the same named individual may utilize different addresses. This scenario detects instances in which multiple, seemingly unrelated entities are using the same address in their transactions, which could be indicative of a money laundering or fraud ring.

The following approach has been followed while implementing the scenario.
[1] Datasets for each party role in each of the Monetary Instrument transaction table and the Wire transaction tables obtained for the lookback period.
[2] Union of all the tables is obtained to get a dataset integrating data for different party roles across tables.
[3] For each External Entity involved in each of the transactions, apply check conditions.
